contentHtml:
From a glitchy laptop or a stubborn printer to "is this email a scam?", I give fast, plain-English answers without the jargon. If the question turns out to be trickier than it looked, I can jump straight into remote support or an onsite visit around Stretton and Brisbane. One call, one answer, no stress.

A real person, not a bot

  • Plain English. You talk to a technician who explains things in a way that makes sense, not a script.
  • Fix or teach. I sort the problem and, if you want, show you how to head it off next time.
  • Across the board. Windows 11, macOS, Android, iOS, NBN routers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, all fair game.
  • Security-minded. The advice always keeps your privacy, scam defence and Australian data rules in view.

The sort of thing people ask

Slow boots, a laptop overheating, storage nearly full or random freezes. Strange pop-ups, a suspicious email, or "have I been hacked?". Which laptop to buy, whether a repair is worth it, or how to get two devices talking to each other. If it is tech, I have probably fielded it before. When it turns into a hands-on fault, see my general troubleshooting service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
